title: Windows Ready Print & Windows Protected Print Mode (WPP) — Intune Deployment, Compatibility Assessment & Legacy Print-Server Migration
author_notes: Pricing: T4 implementation (assessment + config + legacy print-server migration + hardening), matches ANDROIDCOSU tier ($899). Commercial $899, NPO 539.40, Gov 764.15.
Topic: deploy Microsoft's modern driverless print platform (Windows Ready Print) and harden it with Windows Protected Print mode (WPP) via Intune. Requested by owner from a detailed context brief.

VERIFIED (Microsoft Learn windows/modern-print/windows-protected-print-mode + multiple 2026 field sources): WPP = Windows 11 24H2+ security mode that forces Windows Ready Print and blocks third-party V3/V4 drivers + third-party Point-and-Print (PrintNightmare surface). Windows Ready Print = driverless platform over IPP/Mopria/eSCL/Universal Print using the built-in Microsoft IPP Class Driver. Enabling WPP REMOVES printers using unsupported third-party drivers + their drivers from the store; Mopria printers reinstall via Ready Print; some legacy software printers removed; some MFD scanning breaks unless eSCL/Mopria. Device-scoped (affects all users).

CSP: ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/Printers/ConfigureWindowsProtectedPrint (Win11 24H2+, Pro/Ent/Edu/IoT Ent). GPO: Computer Configuration > Printers > Configure Windows protected print. Registry HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Printers\WPP value WindowsProtectedPrintGroupPolicyState. CRITICAL: NOT yet in Settings Catalog -> deploy via Custom OMA-URI, Data type String, Value <enabled/> (or <disabled/>).

5 PowerShell scripts (5.1+, parse-verified): WPPRINT-Get-PrintDriverInventory (third-party vs IPP-class), WPPRINT-Test-MopriaReadiness (IPP/IPPS reachability + IPP class driver), WPPRINT-Test-ScanCapability (eSCL probe), WPPRINT-Get-WPPState (24H2 eligibility + registry state), WPPRINT-Validate-Deployment (enabled + no third-party drivers + IPP-class binding).

Assessment-first is the safety gate: WPP removes incompatible printers, so inventory drivers/Mopria/eSCL BEFORE enabling. Phase 1-7 runbook: assess -> design target (Ready Print/Universal Print) -> Custom OMA-URI profile scoped to 24H2 filter -> pilot+validate -> migrate off legacy print servers/Point-and-Print -> ring rollout -> prevent regression.
